transcript_summary: Chad Millman and professional bettor Simon Hunter analyze early market moves, injury reports, and sharp betting action across the Week 6 NFL slate. They highlight their featured picks, including Simon Says on the Browns and Chad's Choice on the Raiders.

extracted_picks.speaker: Simon Hunter
extracted_picks.rationale: Official Simon Says pick. Simon backs Cleveland catching 4.5 at home against Baltimore in an AFC North divisional clash.
extracted_picks.quote: Simon says, 'Give me the Browns plus four and a half.'

extracted_picks.speaker: Chad Millman
extracted_picks.rationale: Official Chad's Choice pick. Backs Las Vegas +5.5 at home off a blowout loss against Buffalo traveling on a short week.
extracted_picks.quote: Don't care if Jay Cutler would say don't care. Give me the Raiders plus 5 and a half.

extracted_picks.speaker: Chad Millman
extracted_picks.rationale: Chad bets Carolina getting 1.5 points on the road against an injury-plagued Eagles team coming off their London trip.
extracted_picks.quote: And I told him, 'Well, I already bet the Panthers.'

extracted_picks.speaker: Chad Millman
extracted_picks.rationale: Chad backs the Jets getting 7.5 points on the road in New England to fade the public surge on Drake Maye.

extracted_picks.speaker: Simon Hunter

extracted_picks.quote: Aren't we supposed to just blindly bet the Cardinals here?

extracted_picks.speaker: Simon Hunter

extracted_picks.quote: taking a teaser here. But you're getting two and a half with Mahomes at home. It just feels like a good number against a team that hasn't won a game yet this year.

analysis_notes.topic: Home underdog off blowout historical trend
analysis_notes.summary: Chad cites historical data showing home underdogs coming off a blowout loss cover 56-57% ATS since 2003, while targeting Brock Bowers against Buffalo's 23rd-ranked tight end defense.
analysis_notes.speaker: Chad Millman
analysis_notes.quote: home dog off of a blowout loss since 2003. 57% against the spread. Good team off of a blowout loss. 55% against the spread.

analysis_notes.summary: Simon highlights the Rams defense repeatedly surrendering chunk rushing yardage up the middle, pointing to Josh Allen's late fourth-quarter rushing explosion as evidence.
analysis_notes.speaker: Simon Hunter
analysis_notes.quote: can you stop a run up the middle Rams? I don't know if you can. I mean Josh Allen supposedly had a bad knee. He ran for what was it? 90 yards in that fourth quarter overtime.

analysis_notes.topic: Sharp money discrepancy on Dallas Cowboys
analysis_notes.summary: Chad and Simon note that despite the public abandoning Dallas after a blowout loss, ticket counts are split and sharp professional money is backing the Cowboys getting points in Green Bay.
analysis_notes.speaker: Chad Millman
analysis_notes.quote: tickets are pretty split, but money is definitely on the Cowboys. Um there's no there's no doubt about it. It's definitely one of the more uh more wise guys sides.

analysis_notes.topic: Eagles return from London vs rested Panthers
analysis_notes.summary: Simon notes Carolina is well-rested coming off a bye week while the Eagles face a sluggish travel spot returning from their international game in London.
analysis_notes.speaker: Simon Hunter
analysis_notes.quote: Like Bryce Young is really good. They're coming off a bye-week. Eagles are coming back from England.

analysis_notes.summary: Simon warns that San Francisco laying 7.5 points on Monday night is an archetype trap game after dominating a grueling division stretch.
analysis_notes.speaker: Simon Hunter
analysis_notes.quote: Dumb dumb trap spot that you never see coming where they've just now beat up, you could say they've beaten four of the best seven teams in the NFL
